release_notes: Build 56 adds a second-stage Library recovery for installations where Build 55 still shows an empty Library or YouTube Manager.
The new pass ignores the old recovery marker unless the installed database actually contains project, quiz-question or Quiz History rows.

Recovery now follows previous migration markers and project-folder ancestry, then performs a bounded search of common user folders and other fixed drives when the original checkout was stored somewhere unexpected.
Candidate SQLite databases are identified by the FactVault projects, quiz_questions and quiz_history tables, so the source file does not need to use one exact hard-coded filename or location.
A database containing only upload-journal rows can no longer block recovery of the real Library and Quiz History database.
The installed database is still never replaced when it already contains real Library/history rows, and a rollback copy is made before any recovery replacement.
A local installed-library-recovery-v2-diagnostics.json report records the candidate paths and row counts without storing API credentials, making any remaining path issue directly diagnosable.
